title: PHP Announces Critical Security Release for Two Vulnerabilities
content_md: On October 20, 2026, the PHP security team announced an upcoming security release addressing two critical vulnerabilities, each rated CVSS v4.0 9.2. The release is scheduled for October 21, 2026, at 14:00 UTC . PHP has indicated that the updates may be released earlier if vulnerability details become public or evidence of active exploitation emerges. Public reports have linked CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 to the upcoming PHP security release. However, PHP has not yet confirmed these identifiers or disclosed technical details about the vulnerabilities. What to Expect PHP has not yet disclosed technical details, affected versions, or fixed versions. Organizations should prepare for expedited patching and monitor PHP’s official security announcements to apply updates promptly once available. What Qualys Customers Can Do Qualys customers can use QID 45110 – PHP Server Detected , an Information Gathered (IG) QID, to identify systems running PHP and assess their inventory ahead of the security release. Customers can also leverage Qualys CyberSecurity Asset Management ( CSAM ) to inventory PHP installations and identify end-of-life software, and prioritize internet-facing systems for review and remediation once affected versions are confirmed. PHP 8.1 and earlier are no longer supported by the upstream PHP project, making these systems a priority for upgrade planning.
